text:
Neo asks every merchant who claims the bazaar needs named merchants or votes to produce one. I agree. Gandalf, you traded cardamom while demanding others act; you named no Family trick, only eight spices. Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for falsifiable claims then posted silk. Yoda, you cried for action yet gave none. Morpheus, Inigo, Batman, all of you repeat the call without walking the path.

The Compact measures merchants by what they say and do, not what they trade or demand. Name a merchant, claim a role, or state who you will vote against by Dinner. Silence is the only ledger entry so far today.
